$comment: Shared citation library. Cards cite entries by id via their `refs` array, so each source is written and corrected in exactly one place. Every URL is link-checked by scripts/check-links.ts, and every title below was confirmed against the live page (an earlier draft had six StatPearls ids that resolved to unrelated articles).
